File Metadata as a Tibble

Source: R/path_utils.R
file_meta_fs.Rd

Vectorized file information from [fs::file_info()], with names and parent folders split out for joining.

Usage

file_meta_fs(paths)

Arguments

paths

Character vector of file paths.

Value

A tibble with one row per path: `path`, `file_name`, `dir_name` (parent folder name), `dir_path`, `m_time` (modified), `c_time` (created, falling back to changed, then modified), `size` in bytes, and `uname` (owner, where the platform reports one).

See also

[scan_data_io()]

Examples

f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
writeLines("a,b", f)
file_meta_fs(f)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   path       file_name dir_name dir_path m_time              c_time             
#>   <chr>      <chr>     <chr>    <chr>    <dttm>              <dttm>             
#> 1 /tmp/Rtmp… file1cb1… RtmpvnJ… /tmp/Rt… 2026-09-13 17:38:51 2026-09-13 17:38:51
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: size <dbl>, uname <chr>
